hook: TorchTPU went from 5.7x slower to 25% faster

beats.say: Andrey Lukyanenko ported his Cayley graph puzzle solver to TorchTPU, Google's native PyTorch backend for TPUs.
The first port trained 1.65 times slower than an A100, and its beam search ran 5.7 times slower than his JAX version.
After fixing eager execution, attention and dynamic shapes, training matched the A100 and beam search ran 25 percent faster per level than JAX.
